global_null.unit: one shared row-label permutation of full CRC CRISPR matrix per draw
global_null.statistic: median vulnerability rho across 4 biological backgrounds; HCT116 median across its 3 trajectories
global_null.self_line_exclusion: applied after the shared permutation for each trajectory
global_null.p_value_combination: none; no Fisher; direct global empirical p followed by BH

final_shortlist_criteria: leave-HCT116-out median rho > 0 and >=2/3 remaining backgrounds positive
internal_stability_reclassification: Phase 7B-R2 19 candidates are reported as internally cross-method-stable, not robust vulnerabilities.
raw_data_policy: Raw DepMap/GEO files remain local and ignored by git; only derived R3 outputs and scripts are committed.
